WITH store_customers AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002
      AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
 web_customers AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002
      AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
),
 catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002
      AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM
    customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cdemo ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = store_customers.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = web_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_customers ON c.c_customer_sk = catalog_customers.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE
    ca.ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
    AND web_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
    AND catalog_customers.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
